concerns.text: T003 generates simulated hosts with descriptors 'from real host descriptor statistics in data/raw/descriptors_added.csv' — but in the expected zero-records path (T001's honest empty outcome), descriptors_added.csv is empty, making the simulation input undefined and T003 unexecutable. Plan T001b instead specifies a verified HuggingFace SMILES parquet (200 molecules, seed 42). Pick one concrete, always-available simulation source and state it in T003.

T004 requires model_runs.json to conform to BOTH model_output.schema.yaml and output.schema.yaml. The two schemas have incompatible required shapes (nested `metrics` object vs top-level r2_mean/r2_std/cross_validation_folds) and output.schema.yaml sets additionalProperties: false, so a single JSON cannot satisfy both. Name which schema (or which per-file split, e.g. per-model metrics JSONs vs model_runs.json) each artifact validates against.

The plan's independent evaluation set (independent_eval.csv, feature-independent N(0,1) targets) and task T011 (evaluate on hold-out, append report section) have no corresponding task in tasks.md. Either add a task producing data/processed/independent_eval.csv and the appended report section, or the plan must be revised to drop it — currently an implementer following tasks.md cannot satisfy the plan.

Retry policy contradicts: tasks.md T001 says 'max 3 retries', plan T001a says 'max 5 retries'. FR-001 leaves it unspecified; pick one value in both artifacts so the T001 unit test and reproducibility check (T009) are deterministic.

Bootstrap resample counts disagree: T005 says '≥50 resamples', plan T006 says 1000. A range ('≥50') also makes T009's reproducibility check (identical stability CVs across runs) non-deterministic. Pin an exact count (e.g. 1000, seed 42) in T005.

Report path and script layout contradict: plan places report at data/processed/report.md with scripts 06_partial_dependence.py/07_independent_evaluation.py; tasks.md writes data/results/report.md and folds PDPs into 04_feature_analysis.py. T009's 're-run the documented quickstart.md command sequence' is unexecutable while the two artifacts name different entry points and outputs — reconcile paths/script names.

T006 says statistical_summary.json conforms to 'the bootstrap_ci block of output.schema.yaml (multiple entries allowed)', but output.schema.yaml defines bootstrap_ci as a single object and data-model.md says model_runs.json is a list while model_output.schema.yaml validates a single object. State the concrete JSON shape (e.g. array of bootstrap_ci objects under a named wrapper) so schema validation in T007 is executable.

concerns.text: Plan task T010 (Reference-Validator citation verification) has no tasks.md counterpart; tasks.md removes it implicitly under 'platform-owned concerns'. Citation verification of research.md URLs is a project deliverable per the plan's Constitution Check, not platform CI — either restore a task or record the explicit decision in the plan.
